sendVerificationSecureSms:
mutation sendVerificationSecureSms(
	$phoneDialCode: String!
	$phoneNumber: String!
	$deviceId: String!
	$deviceType: String!
	$userType: Int,
	$securityKey: String!
) {
	sendVerificationSecureSms(
		phoneDialCode: $phoneDialCode
		phoneNumber: $phoneNumber
		deviceId: $deviceId
		deviceType: $deviceType
		userType: $userType,
		securityKey: $securityKey
	) {
		status
		errorMessage
		phoneNumber
		phoneDialCode
	}
}
signup_mutation:
mutation (
    $firstName: String, 
    $lastName: String, 
    $email: String!, 
    $password: String!, 
    $phoneDialCode: String!,
    $phoneNumber: String!,
    $phoneCountryCode: String!,
    $lat: Float,
    $lng: Float,
    $city: String,
    $state:String,
    $zipcode: String,
    $country: String,
    $vehicleName: String,
    $vehicleType: Int,
    $vehicleNumber: String,
    $userType: Int!,
    $deviceType: String!,
    $deviceId: String!,
	$vehicleColor: String
,
  $preferredLanguage: String

	$isChildSeatAvailable: Boolean,
	$isWheelChairAvailable: Boolean
,  $gender: String
$vehicleMakeYear: String
	$vehicleModal: String
	$vehicleImage: String) {
    createUser (
        firstName: $firstName, 
 vehicleMakeYear: $vehicleMakeYear
		vehicleModal: $vehicleModal
		vehicleImage: $vehicleImage       lastName: $lastName, 
        email: $email, 
        password: $password,
        phoneDialCode: $phoneDialCode,
        phoneNumber: $phoneNumber,
        phoneCountryCode: $phoneCountryCode,
        lat: $lat,
        lng: $lng,
        city: $city,
        state: $state,
        zipcode: $zipcode,
        country: $country,
        vehicleName: $vehicleName,
        vehicleType: $vehicleType,
        vehicleNumber: $vehicleNumber,
        userType: $userType,
        deviceType: $deviceType,
        deviceId: $deviceId, 
        preferredLanguage: $preferredLanguage   ,
		vehicleColor: $vehicleColor,isChildSeatAvailable: $isChildSeatAvailable,
		isWheelChairAvailable: $isWheelChairAvailable
		gender: $gender   ) {
        result {
            userId
            userToken
email
phoneNumber
            user {
              firstName
              lastName
              
              preferredLanguage
              preferredCurrency
              status
              country
              createdAt
            }
           }
     	status
            errorMessage
    }
}

vehiclesCreateMutation:
mutation vehiclesCreate(
    $vehicleName: String,
 $vehicleMakeYear: String,
$vehicleModal: String,
$vehicleImage: String,
    $vehicleType: Int,
    $vehicleNumber: String,
 $vehicleColor: String
	$isChildSeatAvailable: Boolean
	$isWheelChairAvailable: Boolean
   $id: Int
) {
    vehiclesCreate (
        vehicleName: $vehicleName,
   vehicleMakeYear: $vehicleMakeYear,
   vehicleModal: $vehicleModal,
   vehicleImage: $vehicleImage,
        vehicleType: $vehicleType,
        vehicleNumber: $vehicleNumber,
    vehicleColor: $vehicleColor
		isChildSeatAvailable: $isChildSeatAvailable
		isWheelChairAvailable: $isWheelChairAvailable
		 id: $id ) {
     	  status
        errorMessage
    }
}
